LAW_BASIS: [196] closes work admission, mutation, and integration and increments ENGINEERING_EPOCH at closure entry.
[197] permits post-barrier participation only for closure/review/audit/read-only work.
[198]-[199] require shard-to-global drain manifests including empty shards.
[200]-[202] define the closure membership manifest and root.
[209] pins MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_HASH and DRAIN_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH in the closure world.
[080] defines MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH as the global bulk-invalidation generation.
[123] denies stale membership mutation authority after global epoch/generation change.

ENTRY_BARRIER_CAS: Increment MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH by exactly 1 as a closure bulk invalidation.

MEMBERSHIP_FORMATION_RULES: All pre-barrier normal memberships are stale after MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH increments and cannot mutate product.
Before the pinned-world snapshot is created, participants needed for closure may renew into the new MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH only with mutation_eligible=false and integration_eligible=false.
No normal product-mutation membership may be created while closure gates are closed.
Transition from CLOSURE_MEMBERSHIP_FORMING to CLOSURE_MEMBERSHIP_FREEZING closes all normal membership create/update admission for the closure membership epoch.
SHARD_FREEZE_PROTOCOL: For every logical membership shard in SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH, publish a freeze acknowledgement bound to TARGET_AUTHORITY_KEY, CLOSURE_GENERATION, MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, shard id, exact shard head/tree or immutable shard snapshot id, and freeze generation.
Every shard must acknowledge, including empty shards.
A shard acknowledgement is valid only after all authorized membership writers for the closure membership epoch are drained or invalidated.
Any normal membership write observed after a shard freeze acknowledgement invalidates that acknowledgement and forces REOPEN_REQUIRED.
Only after all shard freeze acknowledgements are valid may the closure membership manifest be materialized and hashed.
PIN_RULE: Materialize the closure membership manifest from the frozen membership-shard snapshots only.
The manifest contains every normal membership record in the closure MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH at the freeze point.
Sort by MEMBERSHIP_ID canonical bytes and compute MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_HASH exactly as required by [200]-[202].
Build DRAIN_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH from every shard, including explicit empty shards.
Persist immutable manifest artifacts and their content hashes before setting PINNED_WORLD_READY.
After PINNED_WORLD_READY, the frozen normal membership namespace is immutable for that CLOSURE_GENERATION.

POST_PIN_JOIN_RULE.STORAGE: Separate sharded observer namespace that is not a normal MEMBERSHIP_RECORD and is excluded from the clause [200] closure membership manifest.
FORBIDDEN: changing the pinned membership or drain universe
POST_PIN_JOIN_RULE.RATIONALE: This preserves [197] participation while preventing post-pin joins from changing the [200]-[209] pinned membership universe.

COMPLETE_PRECONDITIONS_ADDED_BY_REPAIR: The exact immutable MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_HASH artifact still exists and matches the hash pinned for the active CLOSURE_GENERATION.
The exact immutable DRAIN_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH artifact still exists and matches the pinned hash.
Every membership shard freeze acknowledgement remains valid for the same MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH and CLOSURE_GENERATION.
No normal membership write exists after its shard freeze acknowledgement.
Observer records are excluded from normal membership roots and have mutation_eligible=false and integration_eligible=false.
All other clause [209] pinned-world components exactly match their pinned values.
Only then may the expected-version COMPLETE CAS of [215] execute.
REOPEN_TRIGGERS: Any normal membership write after freeze.
Any membership or drain root mismatch.
Any observer record that acquires normal membership, mutation, or integration eligibility.
Any change to another pinned-world component.
Any ambiguous control state or crash that prevents proving the frozen universe.
CRASH_RECOVERY: Crash before all shard freeze acknowledgements: remain pre-pin and resume/rebuild freeze acknowledgements; COMPLETE is impossible.
Crash after immutable manifests exist but before PINNED_WORLD_READY fence CAS: revalidate every shard acknowledgement and manifest hash before CAS.
Crash after PINNED_WORLD_READY: resume from the pinned immutable manifest ids; any mismatch forces REOPEN_REQUIRED.
Never infer freeze success from absence of recent writes alone.
TORTURE_TESTS_REQUIRED: Normal-membership write racing the per-shard freeze acknowledgement.
Post-pin join storm proving only observer records are created and MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_HASH is unchanged.
Delayed stale writer from the pre-closure MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH.
Shard freeze acknowledgement followed by an unauthorized shard write.
Crash before pin, crash after manifest creation, crash after pin, and retry.
Two independent sweeps plus a post-sweep observer join immediately before COMPLETE CAS.
Verify the observer join cannot alter any pinned closure root or authoritative fence predicate.
SAFETY_ARGUMENT: The confirmed counterexample requires a post-pin write to the normal current closure membership universe that does not alter Mission Fence STATE_VERSION. This repair removes that transition from the valid state space: normal membership writes are frozen before pin and post-pin participants use a separate read-only observer namespace. Therefore sharded observer activity cannot change MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_HASH or DRAIN_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH, and any illegal write to the frozen namespace is a closure blocker that forces REOPEN.
